messages:
sanjay_releases: Heads-up — we have a planned deploy for Dedicated GPU pools tonight. Need final customer-facing comms + statuspage snippet. ETA: 02:00–03:00 UTC. Will include kernel patch and minor model pinning.

emma_support: copying the template from last quarter and trimming for EU customers. drafting short statuspage and email. any hard constraints on pinning?

raj_eng: pinning only v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 for the rollover path, so fallback is available if performance regression detected. rollout will be phased by region.

olivia_cust_ops: can we confirm whether Dedicated customers with reserved capacity get an opt-out? some enterprise accounts asked to delay if they have business-critical windows.

raj_eng: yes — enterprise reserved pools get a config toggle. ops will run a focused window for only shared-hosted first, then Dedicated. we'll only touch Dedicated if shared is green.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: start=2026-03-25T02:00:00Z, end=2026-03-25T03:00:00Z, targets=[shared-hosted, dedicated-eu], canary=10%. Reaction: :rocket:

emma_support: draft statuspage snippet for review: ```Scheduled Maintenance: Kernel patch and rollback-safe model pinning. Start: 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC. Expected impact: brief 1–3 min request slowdowns during node restarts for shared-hosted. Dedicated customers should see no interruption unless opted in. Incidents will be posted here.```

sanjay_releases: OK. Add short email subject lines: "Planned maintenance: service updates (Mar 25, UTC)" and a TL;DR line: "No action required for most customers; enterprise opt-outs available."

emma_support: adding a small FAQ section for support copy: - Q: Will my running jobs be interrupted? A: Shared-hosted may see short token delays; Dedicated reserved pools are isolated unless specifically scheduled. - Q: What is rollback plan? A: Immediate pin to previous model + traffic shift to fallback region.

raj_eng: rollback playbook (condensed): 1) Abort rollout, 2) Pin endpoints to v2.3.0, 3) Re-route 25% traffic to fallback region for 10m, 4) Notify oncall + customer ops. Keep logs: `curl -XPOST https://ops.internal/pin -d '{"model":"v2.3.0"}'`

olivia_cust_ops: please include contact link to dedicated-account teams and mention SLA exceptions if they request delayed window. I'll prepare the opt-out form link.

emma_support: email body draft ready for review: "Hi — We will perform maintenance on Mar 25 02:00–03:00 UTC to apply kernel security and adjust model pinning. Most customers: no action needed. If you'd like to opt out or delay for an enterprise SLA exception, reply to this email or use [opt-out link]."

statusbot: Statuspage entry queued: ID=inc_20260325_kernel_pin, visibility=public, scheduled_start=2026-03-25T02:00:00Z

sanjay_releases: final checklist before publish: - confirm opt-out link live (olivia) - final timeframe in localized zones (emma) - rollback playbook pinned in runbook and alerted to oncall (raj)

olivia_cust_ops: opt-out link up: https://redwood.example.com/maintenance-optout/2026-03-25

emma_support: localized times: PST=2026-03-24 18:00, CET=2026-03-25 03:00. updating email and statuspage copy.

raj_eng: runbook updated and oncall notified. I'll keep a watch during canary and hold if any latency spikes >20% over baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 10% on shared-hosted. Monitor window 10m.

emma_support: publishing statuspage and sending emails now. Posting thread in #customers-updates too.

sanjay_releases: thanks — keep this thread for any rollback decisions. If we roll back, we publish an incident update with cause and mitigation steps. :white_check_mark:
